title: Initial setup quickstart cards and empty-state microcopy
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and deliver a set of Quickstart 'setup cards' and empty-state illustrations + microcopy for the Console onboarding tour. Goals: reduce time-to-first-success for new orgs, surface recommended first tasks (API key, deploy sample model, review billing), and provide graceful empty states for routes with no data (routes, models, logs). Deliverables include Figma artboards, compressed PNG/SVG exports for the Console release, microcopy file, and handoff notes for implementation.
acceptance_criteria: 3 distinct quickstart cards (Get API key, Launch sample deployment, Create a first route) with desktop and narrow-width variants
Empty-state illustrations for Routes, Models, Usage, and Error traces with accessible color variants
Microcopy content reviewed by PM and UX writing: onboarding tips, CTA labels, tooltips
All assets exported (SVG/2x PNG) and uploaded to Drive with a matching Figma file and implementation tokens
Design QA pass: components match specs and appear correctly in staging build (staging.redwood.console)
design_notes: Kept illustrations minimal and brand-adjacent to avoid distracting engineers during first run.
Card CTAs follow progressive disclosure: primary action (Get API key) is single-click, secondary actions are contextual links.
Opted for neutral-contrast illustrations to avoid failing contrast on dark mode; developer guidance in handoff for alt text.
Trade-off: small animation was requested (pulse on primary CTA) but deferred to engineering for perf and accessibility evaluation; added as follow-up task ENG-3019.
Internationalization: microcopy avoids idioms and keeps strings under 90 chars where possible to reduce i18n layout breaks.
implementation_notes: Provide exported SVG with separate layers for decorative and semantic elements so devs can disable animations.
Recommend using Lottie only for the optional pulse; default to static SVG to meet low-bandwidth orgs.
Expose data hooks for telemetry (onboarding card clicked) so PM can measure completion funnel.
